title: Glessner's dining bay and courtyard windows get their stonework right
items: Each corner of Glessner House's dining-room bay is now one tall stone between the windows, as the 1923 and 2024 photographs show, where brick and two thin jamb stones stood.

The courtyard windows between the dining bay and the round hall bay now sit under continuous stone lintel courses that run on into the hall bay's own courses. The upper windows had no lintels at all before.
